figures.caption: Table 3: Quantitative evaluation of motion capture performance across various I2V models and threat scenarios on the FoT benchmark.
Fig. 1: A threat scenario that Flow of Truth (FoT) handles. Our method recovers the truthful source behind I2V manipulations.

Fig. 2: Training of Flow of Truth (FoT). (1) Template Embedding, which implants a learnable forensic template into an image while preserving its fidelity; (2) Image-to-Video Simulation, which emulates how I2V generation disperses and deforms pixel evidence through predefined motion fields; (3) Motion Capture, which reconstructs the original forensic trace by following predicted pixel motions.
